development_build_city.objective: Use the settler to choose a resource-rich location and found a city meeting the native mini_goal before the native turn deadline. Founding a city ends the task, including when its score is below the goal. mini_score before settlement describes the current settler-tile candidate score. Movement consumes movement points; END_TURN replenishes movement according to native rules. Use only known terrain and current legal actions.
development_build_city.success_definition: Native success/is_mini_success == 1; city-built callback compares its native map score to score_goal with tolerance 0.0001. Do not expose map_conf to the agent.
development_build_city.native_turn_limit: Read max_turn from each episode; inspected normal save has 30.

development_transport.objective: Use settlers and galleons to travel to new land and found a city before the native turn deadline. A land unit can board an eligible same-tile ship in a city; adjacent embark actions board a specified ship. Transport the settler by moving its carrier, and use a legal directional disembark action to land. Generic deboard/unload actions require a city and are not interchangeable with landing on an empty shore. Follow current action availability and movement feedback. Native success is set by the human city-built event, independently of mini_score; verify the intended transport sequence from the observed state.
development_transport.success_definition: Native success/is_mini_success == 1; Lua human city_built callback sets success directly. mini_score can remain 0 with mini_goal 1. Lua does not independently verify a continent change.
development_transport.native_turn_limit: Read max_turn from each episode; inspected normal save has 10.
